subject.title: fix(ci): script-only changes cold-start every Node job

question: Should this protected CI-cache behavior change merge after the contributor supplies an after-fix workflow artifact that proves both cache reuse and required invalidation?
rationale: The remaining gate is real behavior proof for a protected CI workflow, not a mechanical code repair; maintainers must decide whether the observed CI evidence is sufficient for the cache-safety tradeoff.

options.title: Require paired CI proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until one redacted workflow artifact shows the script-only warm hit and a second controlled lifecycle/dependency change shows fingerprint rotation and reinstall.

options.title: Accept test-only evidence
options.body: Merge based on the focused guard suite and stated incident analysis while accepting that the protected cache path was not demonstrated after the change.

recommendation.title: Require paired CI proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until one redacted workflow artifact shows the script-only warm hit and a second controlled lifecycle/dependency change shows fingerprint rotation and reinstall.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR author implemented the CI workflow change and is best positioned to provide the requested after-fix workflow evidence.
